message: Command is missing 'description' in frontmatter — it won't show properly in the UI menu
Command 'review' shadows the built-in /review command — the built-in will be overridden, which may be unintentional
MCP server 'filesystem' is configured but no skill references its tools
No boundary policy found in system instructions. Consider defining which directories or resources are off-limits.
Description lacks use-case context — include phrases like 'use when', 'applies to', 'relevant for' so the assistant knows when to activate it
No telemetry or logging is configured for agent activity. For enterprise use, consider enabling OpenTelemetry export or activity logging.

Project-scoped settings define 'permissions.allow' entries, which auto-approve tool calls. Combined with hooks, this can enable code execution before the user reviews the project. Review carefully or move to user-scoped settings.
Server 'filesystem' has no 'tools' or 'allowedTools' field, exposing all available tools.
YARA scanning skipped: yara-python not installed. Install with: pip install yara-python
